bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed. Clutches and fanny packs up to 6" x 9" with one pocket do not need to be clear.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Clutches and fanny packs up to 6" x 9" with no more than one pocket
Hydration packs, emptied, with up to two main compartments and one small one
prohibited: Outside food or beverage, including alcohol
bagPolicy.note: Hydration packs do not need to be clear. Coolers may be allowed for medical use.

parking.note: The festival recommends public transportation. Use the 7 train or LIRR to Mets–Willets Point; the official rideshare point is at the New York Hall of Science when published for the current edition.

rideshare.note: Use the New York Hall of Science for rideshare pickup and drop-off.

concessions.note: The festival features New York City restaurants and Queens vendors. Outside food and beverages are prohibited except approved items required for medical dietary needs.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Visit the Access Center when you arrive for accessibility services. No medical documentation is needed, and one companion wristband is issued per eligible guest (the companion still needs a festival ticket). Accessible viewing areas are first come, first served, and accessible entry lanes are at festival entrances.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: There is no re-entry. Wristbands are scanned when you exit the gate.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Please visit the Box Office to pick up Will Call orders, for wristband assistance, or to upgrade tickets (if available), or to receive support for tickets purchased through the Ticketmaster Verified Exchange.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The Main Entrance is between the Unisphere and Astronaut Court. Check the festival map before you go, since layouts can change.
